Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Chris Shorb & Tammy Martin wrote:
> A malkavian is stolen with Malk Dementia. The original controller of
> the Malk is then ousted in the intervening turn. Does the Malk burn
> at the current controller's untap phase?

At the moment her untap phase begins, yes.
Since she only has control of the Malk "until her next untap phase" and
the Malk is returned to its "base" controller when the Dementia wears
off and cards returned to ousted players are burned [RTR 21-FEB-1996]
